items.q: How does ShopFinder get better prices?
items.a: We aggregate offers from manufacturers, authorized distributors and marketplaces (eBay, AliExpress, Amazon, Newegg, DigiKey) into a single catalog. When you buy, the order is automatically forwarded to the supplier with the best price — you pay once and the rest is invisible.

items.q: What currency are prices shown in?
items.a: Prices are shown in BRL with an hourly-updated USD-BRL rate, so the value reflects the current exchange rate with no checkout surprises.

Each specification can carry its source (manufacturer, datasheet, distributor or marketplace) and a confidence level. Attributes with traced origin and evidence have high confidence; AI estimates show lower confidence and go through review.
The catalog keeps a graph of relations (e.g.: CPU and motherboard with the same socket). On the product page you can see what is compatible before buying, avoiding parts that do not work together.

Revocation does not render unlawful the processing previously carried out and does not delete data that must be retained under a legal obligation or for defense of rights.

sections.title: 5. Data sharing
body: END ART Studios shares data only when necessary, proportionate and compatible with the stated purpose. Recipients and each one's role must be kept up to date in the internal inventory.

We do not sell personal data. We do not share data for third-party behavioral advertising without a legal basis, transparency and, where necessary, consent. Sharing with a supplier must be limited to the data necessary for the offer, order, delivery, warranty and support, with contractual obligations covering security, confidentiality, data subject rights and incidents.

sections.title: 6. International transfers
body: Some providers may process data outside Brazil, including in the United States or other countries, according to the contracted infrastructure. International transfers will only take place where there is a legal hypothesis and a valid mechanism under the LGPD and ANPD regulation, including an adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses, equivalent clauses, specific clauses, global corporate rules or another applicable legal hypothesis.

Before transferring data, END ART Studios must keep a record of the recipient, country or region, data categories, purpose, recipient's role, sub-processors, legal mechanism, safeguards and procedure for exercising rights. The existence of a security certification or sectoral compliance, such as PCI-DSS, is not presented in isolation as the basis for the international transfer.

The providers currently foreseen are: Stripe, Inc. — United States; Vercel, Inc. — United States; Neon, Inc. — United States; OpenAI — United States; and other providers listed in the updated inventory. The list must be corrected before publication if any provider, entity, country or flow differs from the actual operation.

When the AI provider receives data, END ART Studios will apply minimization, contractual instructions, retention controls, training restrictions and segregation. Users' personal data will not be used to train third-party models without a valid legal basis, transparency and adequate controls.

sections.title: 7. Cookies, local storage and similar technologies
body: ShopFinder may use cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage and similar technologies. Effective processing must be described in the Cookie Policy (/cookies), with name, provider, purpose, duration, category and deactivation mechanism.

Storage strictly necessary for the functionality requested by the data subject, for security, authentication or transmission of communication may be used without consent where the law allows. Preferences and any analytics, advertising, non-essential personalization or tracking technologies will only be activated with an adequate legal basis and, where necessary, after consent.

Where there is consent, the data subject will have equivalent options to accept, reject and manage categories, plus permanent access to the preferences panel. Continued browsing will not be used as presumed consent for purposes that require a positive manifestation. Data subjects may revoke or change choices easily.

sections.title: 8. Retention and deletion
body: Data will be kept for the time necessary for the purpose, the contractual relationship, security, handling of rights and legal obligations. The table below is a governance structure and must be filled in and adjusted according to the operation and applicable laws.

After the period ends, data will be deleted, anonymized or blocked, except where retention is required by legal obligation, regular exercise of rights, fraud prevention or another legal hypothesis. Deleting the account does not necessarily delete records that END ART Studios is required to keep.

sections.title: 9. Security and confidentiality
body: END ART Studios adopts technical and administrative measures proportionate to the risk, including encryption in transit where applicable, credential protection, access control by need, audit records, vulnerability management, backups, environment segregation, supplier management and training.

No transmission or storage is absolutely secure. The company reviews its security measures considering the nature of the data, the purpose, the state of the art and the identified risks. The security obligation remains after processing ends to the extent required by law and contracts.
Data subjects must keep their credentials confidential, use a secure device and immediately report any suspicion of unauthorized access. END ART Studios will never request full passwords by e-mail.

sections.title: 10. Security incidents
body: END ART Studios maintains a procedure to identify, contain, investigate, remediate and document incidents. Operators and suppliers must promptly communicate any event to END ART Studios and cooperate with the assessment.

Where the incident may cause relevant risk or damage to data subjects, END ART Studios will notify the ANPD and affected data subjects within the period and in the form set out in the LGPD and current regulation, including ANPD Resolution No. 15/2024. The notice will state, where applicable, the nature of the data, data subjects involved, risks, protection measures, mitigation measures and contact channel. Notice to the ANPD does not replace notice to data subjects where the latter is required.

sections.title: 11. Artificial intelligence, recommendations and automated decisions
body: ShopFinder may use automated rules, statistical models and artificial intelligence tools to normalize information, summarize specifications, identify compatibility, organize the catalog and recommend or order products.

Outputs may contain errors. Recommendations, Authority and Coverage scores, compatibility or trust indicators do not constitute certification, quality guarantee, manufacturer endorsement, professional advice or a promise of performance. The corresponding page must state the general methodology, sources, update date, limitations and any sponsored placement.

END ART Studios does not use AI to decide alone on civil rights, credit, mandatory contracting or essential access of the data subject. Where automated processing affects the data subject's interests, they may request information about criteria and procedures and human review, subject to legitimate trade and industrial secrets and legal limits.

END ART Studios will not use sensitive personal data for ordinary recommendations. Personal data sent to the AI provider will be minimized, pseudonymized or deleted where possible, processed under contract and not used for third-party training without a valid basis.

sections.title: 12. Data subject rights
body: Under the LGPD, data subjects may request, where applicable: confirmation of the existence of processing; access to data; correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data; anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary or unlawfully processed data; portability, subject to regulation; deletion of data processed on the basis of consent, subject to legal exceptions; information about entities with which data has been shared; information about the possibility of not providing consent and its consequences; revocation of consent; objection to processing carried out in certain hypotheses; review of automated decisions; and petition before the ANPD.

Requests must be sent to the DPO channel. To protect the account, END ART Studios may request proportionate proof of identity or authority, without demanding excessive data. Requests will be answered within the applicable statutory and regulatory periods; the company may provide reasoned notice of legal, technical or operational impossibility, without unduly restricting rights.
If data subjects consider the response insufficient, they may request reassessment by the DPO and use the ANPD or judicial channels, without prejudice to consumer rights.

sections.title: 13. Children and adolescents
body: ShopFinder has a catalog accessible to the public but is not directed at children. Account creation, contracting and data collection must observe legal capacity, best interest, applicable law and age-appropriate protection measures.

END ART Studios does not intentionally request children's data for purposes incompatible with the LGPD. If improper collection is identified, it will take reasonable measures to verify the occurrence, delete or protect the data and contact a guardian where appropriate. Parents, guardians or adolescents may use the DPO channel to raise questions or request action.

sections.title: 14. Third-party services and external links
sections.body: ShopFinder may contain links to or integrations with suppliers, marketplaces, manufacturers, payment processors and other websites. Upon leaving ShopFinder, processing follows the third party's policies and terms. The existence of a link does not imply endorsement, warranty or control by END ART Studios over the content or practices of the third party.

sections.title: 15. Changes to this Policy
body: This Policy may be updated to reflect legal, technical, operational or security changes. The current version, the update date and a reasonable version history will be made available on this page.

Material changes will be communicated by appropriate means and, where required, will depend on new consent or acceptance. Changes will not retroactively reduce rights related to processing already carried out nor modify completed purchase contracts, except on a valid legal basis.

sections.title: 16. Governing law and contact
body: This Policy will be interpreted according to applicable Brazilian law, especially Law No. 13.709/2018 (LGPD), the Brazilian Internet Civil Framework, the Consumer Defense Code and ANPD rules. Non-waivable rights of data subjects and consumers prevail over any incompatible provision.

scores.authorityDef: Authority (0–100) measures how trustworthy the origin of each piece of catalog information is.
scores.authorityFactors: Policy default-authority-v1 — weighted average of 4 factors: source type (40% — manufacturer 100, datasheet 95, distributor 80, retailer 70, marketplace 60), evidence confidence (30%), freshness (15% — decays over 30 days) and connector quality (15% — official API 100, mirror 80, scraper 70, partner 60).
scores.priceAuthority: Price and stock carry low authority as a manufacturer statement (10 and 5 out of 100): that data comes from supplier offers, not from the manufacturer.
scores.coverageDef: Coverage (0–100) measures how complete each manufacturer's data is in the catalog, per product segment.
scores.tiers: Manufacturers are grouped into tiers by Authority: A ≥ 98, B 92–97, C 82–91, D < 82.
scores.sourcesLine: Sources: our own catalog and integrated suppliers — manufacturer profiles, offers and evidence with URL and collection date.
scores.updatedLine: Indicators are updated along with the catalog; each product page shows "Updated at" with the data timestamp.
scores.aiLine: Where AI comes in: specification normalization, data enrichment and compatible-product matching via the knowledge graph. Outputs may contain errors and do not replace verification by the user or the supplier.
scores.limitations: Limitations: the indicators may contain errors; they are not a certification, quality guarantee, manufacturer endorsement or official recommendation.
scores.notSponsored: Unsponsored ranking: no payment, advertising or paid placement affects the score.
scores.contest: Want to contest information or a score? Reach us via /contato or endart.studios@gmail.com.
